title: Benimle Yan 3
author: Beyza Özaydın
description: Series synopsis: Ayaz and Masal’s story begins with a car accident that sparks a chain of unforgettable encounters. From fiery clashes to moments of unexpected tenderness, their love–hate relationship keeps everyone around them astonished. What starts as rivalry gradually blossoms into a complicated love, marked by laughter, conflict, and the slow recognition of feelings too strong to ignore. As the trilogy unfolds, side characters Anıl, Hande, Atalay, and Selin bring their own secrets and heartbreaks into the picture, weaving a rich tapestry of friendship, betrayal, and longing. In the final installment, hidden truths surface, testing bonds and shaking loyalties.
